source.title: Midnight Enchanting Guide: Recipes & Knowledge Points

notes: Guide author's approximate Glimmering Powder drop-rate estimate after a few hundred disenchant attempts pooled across gear qualities; no per-quality cast denominator, exact hits, output item ID, build, skill or specialization. Weekly Enchanting tasks must be completed before this catch-up knowledge material begins dropping. This is NOT a baseline dust/shard/crystal material yield, and must not be applied to ordinary disenchant EV. Percentages are approximate, not measured exact hits.
specialization: Weekly Enchanting tasks completed; catch-up Glimmering Powder unlocked
